_comment: Shared vectors for the English-only guard: apps/api/src/llm/english.ts and apps/interview-agent/app/prepare/language.py are both tested against this file, so the two implementations cannot drift. The Portuguese opening is the reply a learner got on 2026-10-18 (screenshot in the PR).
english: Hi, I'll be your interviewer today. Please keep each answer to about one minute. Tell me about a project you led at your last job.
How would you design a caching layer for a service that serves product prices in São Paulo and Bogotá?
Can you walk me through how you handled a conflict with a stakeholder at Itaú?
What is your experience with React, TypeScript and Node.js in production?
Describe a time you had to deliver bad news to a client. What did you do?
Sorry, I lost my train of thought. Could you say that again?
That's all the time we have. Thank you for your answers, we'll get back to you soon.
Why do you want to work at Mercado Libre as a senior data engineer?
not_english: Olá, sou o entrevistador. Esta conversa será em português, conforme o seu idioma. Vamos começar.
Pode me contar sobre um projeto que você liderou na sua última empresa?
Qual é a sua experiência com React e TypeScript em produção?
Hola, soy tu entrevistador. ¿Puedes contarme sobre tu experiencia en ventas?
¿Cómo manejaste un conflicto con un cliente difícil?
